decisions.reason: The GA4 tracking plugin builds directly on the firm's existing analytics, plugin development, and conversion optimization knowledge, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it.

Although the Universal Analytics plugin is related to the firm's analytics expertise, Google has discontinued Universal Analytics, so the firm can recognize its declining commercial value and should drop it.

The retail system interface plugin leverages the firm's existing interface and integration capabilities for marketplaces and price portals, allowing it to learn from early results and refine the product.
The shop relaunch SEO support service is closely aligned with the firm's established search marketing and analytics services, so the firm can apply its related knowledge to improve it.
